question: Comparing at the same π, is the y-axis value positively or negatively correlated with τ?
responses:
At any fixed π, the solid line (τ=10 years) is above the dashed line (τ=20 years). As τ increases, the y-axis value decreases. So y is negatively correlated with τ.
<answer>Negatively correlated</answer>
